items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: I knew him in Philly. I knew him and I and 'Bama' [Carl WARWICK] Jimmy Hamilton knew Charlie in Philly, yeah

ctx.x: Must of been '43 because we were still working when Roosevelt died in '45. There was Ernie Caceres (inaudible) and Will Bradley and Roy and Charlie and Tommy and we had a hell of a band, 32 pieces, and strings. We used to have a ball.
Would you say, when you say Roy, do you mean Eldrige?
